responsibility: This is the main driver for GCC’s gengtype tool, which scans GTY-annotated source declarations and emits the generated garbage-collection and precompiled-header support files. It manages command-line modes, input-file discovery, plugin-specific operation, state-file read/write, global type/typedef/variable tables, per-language output partitioning, and the final write_types/write_roots/write_rtx_next generation steps, coordinating the parser and state machinery defined in gengtype-parse.cc, gengtype-state.cc, and gengtype.h.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the gengtype generator: it defines the tool’s global state and main control flow, parses options and input/state files, and drives output emission. Unlike gcc/gengtype.h, which only declares the shared type model and cross-file interfaces for the gengtype toolchain, this .cc file performs the actual scanning/orchestration work.
